title: AI 从哪读来的？
summary: 向只读过 13 条网络资料的小 AI 提问，投票信不信它的回答，再透视来源，找出并移除有问题的资料。
format: 老师投屏，全班举手投票和讨论

en.title: Where Did AI Read That?
en.summary: Ask a small AI that has read only 13 web sources, vote on its answers, then trace and remove the bad sources.
en.format: Teacher projects; class votes and discusses
